Spend a night in the Mars colony!
We've seen a fair share of the luxury campsites but Memories of Aicha is something truly unique. Tucked into the red valley whole site resembles more Mars colony than camping site.
Domes are very spacious and comfortable, with AC (important!), bathrooms and running water.
Thanks to the transparent roof you can watch thousands of stars at night right from your bed.
Or admire the Martian views during the day from your private deck - only oriental furniture will remind you that you are still on Earth.

About Us
Memories Aicha
Luxury Camp
The Memories Aicha Luxury Camp consists of 55 tents, nestled in the heart of the Wadi Rum. Bordered by rugged mountains and the stunning Arabian desert, this camp lets you wake up in the wild outdoors without compromising an ounce of luxury. Expect the same amenities and facilities as you would have in a top-class hotel.
Each tent is decorated with plush furnishings and a colour-scheme of yellows, oranges and reds inspired by the colourful sands of the desert. Enjoy air-conditioning throughout the tent as well as showers. In addition to the elegant sleeping area, some tents also have dining and lounge spaces that are perfect for families. Enjoy on-site facilities such as a library, terrace, restaurant and outdoor barbecue area. Expert chefs prepare a range of delicious meals using fresh local ingredients.
From the camp, head out for long days exploring the incredible Wadi Rum. Enjoy a jeep-tour of the red desert, sample a traditional Bedouin dinner cooked under the earth or relax beneath the clear night sky and admire hundreds of glittering stars.
The Junior Luxury Tents (375 sq.ft.) are equipped with a King Bed or two Twin Beds can comfortably accommodate two guests. The tents come with en-suite bathroom and shower, Air conditioning, slippers, bathrobe, bottled mineral water, adapters and a hair dryer.
The Executive Luxury Tents (540 sq.ft.) are equipped with one King Bed and one sofa bed. The tents can accommodate three guests and comes with a living room. The tents come with en-suite bathroom and shower, Air conditioning, slippers, bathrobe, bottled mineral water, adapters and a hair dryer.
The Panoramic Luxury Tents (340 sq.ft.) –ideal for the star gazing are equipped with one king-sized bed. The tents can accommodate two guests and comes with en- suite bathroom and shower. Air conditioning, slippers, bathrobe, Dead Sea products, hot shower, bottled mineral water, adapters and a hair dryer.
The guests can enjoy a continental breakfast and variety of local dishes during the dinner time. Fantastic bar under the rock provides non-alcoholic drinks, shisha and great atmosphere.
Located only a five-minute drive from the Wadi Rum visitors centre
Clear night skies are perfect for stargazing
Excellent local staff are on hand to ensure your stay is a comfortable one
The resort has a family friendly ethos and is the ideal hub for children to have a desert experience
Onsite self-parking is also available. Memories Aicha Luxury Camp is a smoke-free property.
